title: Data Grids and Charts
say: Build me a trading board with live prices, in-row sparklines and candlestick charts
blurb: Opens on the charts tab: a price table with a sparkline drawn inside every row, a line and area chart, and candlesticks, all ticking four times a second. The other tabs run the same grid engine as a formula spreadsheet, a million rows by a thousand columns, and widgets nested inside cells. Every cell is drawn by the Makepad renderer, not by a browser chart library.

title: Finance
say: Build me a personal finance app with accounts, budgets and spending reports
blurb: A complete personal-finance app: overview, transactions, budgets and reports over two years of a generated household ledger. Every screen is a real Makepad view, not a mockup.

title: Glass Kit
say: Make me a settings screen with liquid-glass toggles, buttons, a slider and filter chips
blurb: A component showcase in Makepad's liquid-glass style. The glass refracts the animated background beneath it; toggles, the slider and the segmented control all respond to input.
